caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, closed color shapes, pattern equal to form, a towering black mountain between two slender white castle towers, strips of golden cloud in a white sky, two tattooed figures facing each other below holding golden cups that drip gold into a woven basket, soot black, gold, jade white
